pages.title: Juggling Trick
pages.text: The Dagger Glove throws daggers out in patterns, or homes them onto a target. Carry the glove to switch the wheel, then use the glove to pour out fire.

$(bold)Single$()$(br)One dagger, straight ahead.$(br)$(bold)Fan$()$(br)Seven daggers spreading out in a fan before you.$(br)$(bold)Homing$()$(br)Several daggers are thrown, each of which turns onto the target you are looking at.$(br2)The target is outlined in red while you aim at it, and walls do not block it — the daggers turn, so the glove will happily lock on to someone through one.$(br2)With nothing under the crosshair, homing fires nothing and costs you nothing.

$(bold)The daggers are the ammunition$()$(br)The glove draws its daggers out of your whole inventory, and the count it needs must all be there before it fires — a volley it cannot pay for in full simply does not happen.$(br2)Even in creative mode, the glove has to spend real daggers to be used.
